title: ParsedBitbucketEmail
description: A Bitbucket pull request notification email parsed into a structured event.

actorName.description: Display name of the person or bot that caused the event.

isBot.description: True if the actor is a known bot, default is false.

occurredAt.description: UTC timestamp of the event (email sentDateTime).

prNumber.description: Pull request number, if it could be parsed.

repo.description: Repository in workspace/repo form, e.g. testworkspace/repo-slug

PrNotificationCategory.description: COMMENTED: comment created/updated/deleted, human or bot. COMMITS_PUSHED: PR updated with new commits. REVIEW_DECISION: approved, unapproved, changes requested/removed, left a review. RESOLVED: merged or declined. OPENED_OR_ASSIGNED: PR created, reviewer added/removed. UNKNOWN: could not be classified.
